caption:
Faith feels flat when the fire dies down? Zeal was never the foundation. (Amos 4:5 devotional)

Burning zeal can become its own idol; faith stands not on feeling but on Him. It's all right on the days you don't feel it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I measure my faith by how hot I feel — and panic on the dry days?
